noNamedImport.text: This imports a name out of react directly. Reach it through the React namespace instead. A bare `useState` or `Ref` at a call site says nothing about where it came from, so a reader has to go to the import block to find out, and a local binding with the same name shadows it silently. React.useState carries its provenance with it.

noDestructuringFromReact.text: This import takes names out of react without importing React itself, so there is no namespace to reach through and every use in the file has to be a bare name. Import React as the default and use React.* instead.

noCallWithoutPrefix.text: This calls a hook that was destructured out of react. Call it as React.<hook> so the call site says where the hook comes from.

noTypeReferenceWithoutPrefix.text: This uses a type that was destructured out of react. Write it as React.<Type> so the annotation says where the type comes from.
